Name: Forest Alcove Farm 2.0
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[b][size=3]Fixed the issue with the Greenhouse for both versions. [/size]

[u]
Features[/u][/b]
• All grass is tillable 
• Big open area for designing your farm however you like
• Replaces the Wilderness Farm
• If you prefer the old look, just select the optional file from the file archive



[u][b]Requirements[/b][/u]
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets
• Made for Stardew Valley 1.5.5


[u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Forest Alcove Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Wilderness Farm 

[i]

Many thanks to [b]Hakuna's #1 Fan[/b] on the official Stardew Valley Discord for coming up with this wonderful name. ♥[/i]
